channel.title: Art in America - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Art in America (artinamericamagazine.com)

item.title: Lee Krasner and Jackson Pollock to Star in Blockbuster Exhibition at the Met
item.description: The famously married artists are the subjects of a show opening in October.

item.title: Four Suffer Minor Injuries After Michael Joo Sculpture Is Damaged in New York
item.description: Injuries included abrasions and a hairline fracture.

item.title: MOCA Los Angeles Reveals 158 Newly Acquired Works, Including Acclaimed Kara Walker Sculpture
item.description: Fifty of the artists behind those works have never before seen their work acquired by MOCA.

item.title: Louvre Director Laurence des Cars Resigns After Heist and Internal Turmoil
item.description: "Not a single minute of my time has been wasted in service to the Louvre," she said.

item.title: Butter Art Fair Expands to Los Angeles During Frieze Week
item.description: Unlike most commercial fairs, where galleries typically take a commission on works sold, Butter operates under an artist-first model in which participating artists retain 100 percent of sale proceeds.

item.title: In Leaked Transcript, UNT Dean Cites Politics as the Reason Behind Cancelation of Show with Anti-ICE Art Show
item.description: Dean Karen Hutzel reportedly told employees that while the administration might survive the reputational fallout, the college itself could become a target of elected officials.

item.title: Calder Sculpture in Senate Office Building to Be Restored a Decade After Dismantling
item.description: The cloud portion of Mountains and Clouds was removed from the Hart Senate Office Building in 2016.

item.title: Elvira Dyangani Ose, Director of MACBA, Ends Tenure Early Amid Conflict over Abu Dhabi Biennial
item.description: She asked to remain on at the museum while doing the biennial, but MACBA seems to have denied the request.

item.title: Heading Into Frieze After a Year Marked by Fire and ICE, Los Angeles’s Art World Is Poised Between ‘Grief and Hope’
item.description: Major cuts in the entertainment industry have left many longtime supporters strapped.

item.title: Nor’easter Causes Travel Delays for New York Dealers Heading to Frieze Los Angeles
item.description: Most dealers were finally en route, more than a day after they expected to be.
